title: REST request bodies have a size ceiling (413) and repository objects, dashboard history entries and comments are size-capped

criteria.given: an authenticated user POSTs an oversized form body (a 30 MB content field) to /rest/saiku/api/repository/resource
criteria.then: the request answers 413 before the repository stores the object

criteria.given: an anonymous caller POSTs a 5 MB body to the pre-authentication login endpoint /rest/saiku/session
criteria.then: the request answers 413 instead of being read and parsed and then answered 401

criteria.given: a normal-size login and a normal-size repository save
criteria.then: both still answer 200 — the new caps do not block legitimate small requests, and a saved object can be read back and deleted

criteria.given: a documented upload endpoint (dashboard image upload) receives a legitimate 1x1 PNG within its documented 2 MB limit
criteria.then: it still answers 200 (the per-route upload ceiling is high enough to keep uploads working)
